title: Category
statement: A *category* $\mathcal C$ consists of a class of objects; for any two objects $a,b$ a set $\operatorname{Hom}(a,b)$ of morphisms $a\to b$; for every object $a$ an identity morphism $\mathrm{id}_a\in\operatorname{Hom}(a,a)$; and for any three objects a composition map $\operatorname{Hom}(b,c)\times\operatorname{Hom}(a,b)\to\operatorname{Hom}(a,c)$, $(g,f)\mapsto g\circ f$, such that $f\circ\mathrm{id}_a=f=\mathrm{id}_b\circ f$ for every $f:a\to b$ and $h\circ(g\circ f)=(h\circ g)\circ f$ whenever defined.
